extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media relations staff, and the general public interested in SLAC news
extracted.subtask_description: Publishing and presenting institutional press releases, news briefs, features and multimedia on a national laboratory newsroom website, with accompanying media resources for journalists and topic-based collections for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content type labeling (News Release, News Brief, Feature, Multimedia)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pages are explicitly labeled by content type — e.g., 'News Release', 'News Brief', 'Feature', 'Multimedia'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site consistently tags items with their format (examples on page: 'News Release', 'News Brief', 'Feature', 'Multimedia'), which signals expected depth, length, and presentation for each item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise summary/lede under the headline
rubrics_metrics.description: A short descriptive sentence immediately under the headline that summarizes the key finding or significance (the lede).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on the page: 'Their strategy revealed new details that open the door to designing proteins with powerful abilities that could ultimately benefit medicine and manufacturing.' and 'The research sheds light on how a key regulator of inflammation forms, which could help guide new therapeutic approaches to inflammatory diseases.' These one-line summaries orient readers to the main point and importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source attribution / 'VIA' credit for partner content
rubrics_metrics.description: When content originates with or is contributed by a partner institution, it is credited with a 'VIA [Organization]' line (e.g., 'VIA Fermilab', 'VIA Rubin Observatory').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use clear partner attribution for cross-posted or syndicated items; examples on page repeatedly display 'VIA' credits for lab partners and observatories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include publication date and estimated reading time
rubrics_metrics.description: Each item shows a publication date and an estimated 'min read' time (e.g., 'May 4, 2026 · 5 min read').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display both the date and an estimated reading time so readers and journalists can quickly assess timeliness and length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide media resources for journalists (media contact, images & videos, experts, fact sheets)
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated 'For Journalists' / 'Media resources' area links to practical resources: Media contact, Images & videos, Our experts, SLAC topics, Fact sheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site lists these items under 'For Journalists' (seen in page navigation). Press materials should make these resources discoverable to facilitate reporting and rapid use by the media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer multimedia content (videos, images) and label it
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia items are presented with their own entries and short descriptors (e.g., 'How NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory maps the universe every night — This video breaks down...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When available, include embedded or linked videos and image galleries and clearly label them as 'Multimedia' so journalists and readers can access visual assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize content into topic hubs / news collections
rubrics_metrics.description: News is grouped into topical collections or hubs (examples: 'NSF–DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory', 'Fusion energy at SLAC', 'LCLS-II High Energy Upgrade', 'Energy and sustainability', 'COVID-19').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use topic hubs to help readers dive deeper and to aggregate related releases, background, and resources in one place.

rubrics_metrics.name: List recent media mentions and news archive
rubrics_metrics.description: A section ('SLAC in the news' / 'Media mentions' / 'News archive') aggregates coverage of SLAC by external outlets and archives past releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an archive and a 'in the news' media-mentions feed to demonstrate impact and help journalists find prior coverage and context (page shows multiple external media items and an archive link).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge collaborators and partner institutions in the text
rubrics_metrics.description: News items explicitly name collaborating institutions and labs (e.g., Fermilab, Rubin Observatory, Berkeley Lab, Argonne) within the headline/summary or body.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make partner roles and contributions visible in headlines/summaries where relevant so credit and provenance are clear to readers and reporters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include calls-to-action for subscriptions and social sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides options to 'Share' content and to sign up for an email newsletter and RSS feeds (e.g., 'Sign up for our email', 'SLAC’s RSS feeds').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer newsletter sign-up and feed options and prominent share controls to increase distribution and allow journalists/readers to follow updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headlines emphasize main finding and potential impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Headlines are written to highlight the key result and its implication or milestone (examples: 'New detector triples the speed of SLAC’s electron camera, enabling higher sensitivity', 'SLAC scientists capture early stages of immune response inside cells').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write headlines that clearly state the research outcome or milestone and, where appropriate, the practical or scientific significance to attract readers and reporters.
